div.div: Deployment decision: AWS Lambda fits the stated ~8–10 second synchronous query, small dynamic DAG, and per-request scaling. Durable state is externalized to DynamoDB. Revisit Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate if workflows become long-running, require persistent streaming, or need large/native runtime dependencies.
